add.event: 沙特与俄罗斯同意合作管理油价
add.evidence: In September 2016, Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed to cooperate in managing the price of oil

add.event: 俄罗斯拒绝减产要求，非正式伙伴关系终结，油价随即下跌10%
add.evidence: On 6 March 2020, Russia rejected the demand, marking the end of the unofficial partnership, with oil prices falling 10% after the announcement.

add.event: 新冠恐慌叠加价格战，全球股市大幅下跌
add.evidence: On Monday, 9 March 2020, stock markets globally experienced major point drops due to a combination of panic over the COVID-19 pandemic and the price war between Saudi Arabia and Russia.

add.event: 沙特与俄罗斯达成石油减产协议
add.evidence: In early April 2020 and again in June 2020, Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed to oil production cuts.
